objective: Candidate turns a pizza approximately half a turn and releases it on the oven deck; PR-2015 turns a suspended humanoid body to expose its back and installs a cover.
physical_skill: Candidate requires peel insertion and controlled traction against deck friction; PR-2015 requires managing the angular momentum of a freely swiveling heavy suspended body and pressing a cover into place.
success_condition: Candidate directly scores wrapped final yaw, center travel, deck contact, food integrity, release, and tool withdrawal. PR-2015 does not score heading itself; it scores cover alignment/seating and body stillness, with zero for blows, collisions, or excessive residual spin.
reason: Half-turn language is superficial because PR-2015 tests suspended-body spin control plus cover installation, whereas the candidate tests supported food rotation with a peel.
